lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar manasaa manahi samaanee gur kai sabad pachhaataa ||4||
lines.translation: Overcoming my egotism and quieting the desires within my mind, I have come to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: achi(n)t ka(n)m karahi prabh tin ke jin har kaa naam piaaraa ||
lines.translation: God automatically does the work of those who love the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad sadaa man vasiaa sabh kaaj savaaranahaaraa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, he ever dwells in their minds, and He resolves all their affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਵਿਗੁਚੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: onaa kee rees kare s viguchai jin har prabh hai rakhavaaraa ||5||
lines.translation: Whoever challenges them is destroyed; they have the Lord God as their Savior. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve kinai na paaiaa manamukh bhauk mue bilalaaee ||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs die crying out in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahi jaavahi thaur na paavahi dukh mahi dukh samaaee ||
lines.translation: They come and go, and find no place of rest; in pain and suffering, they perish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s a(n)mrit peevai sahaje saach samaaee ||6||
lines.translation: But one who becomes Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, and is easily absorbed in the True Name. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve janam na chhodai je anek karam karai adhikaaee ||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, one cannot escape reincarnation, even by performing numerous rituals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਤੈ ਵਾਦ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ved paRahi tai vaad vakhaanahi bin har pat gavaaee ||
lines.translation: Those who read the Vedas, and argue and debate without the Lord, lose their honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਜਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa satigur saachee jis baanee bhaj chhootahi gur saranaaee ||7||
lines.translation: True is the True Guru, and True is the Word of His Bani; in the Guru's Sanctuary, one is saved. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har man vasiaa se dar saache dar saachai sachiaaraa ||
lines.translation: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord are judged as true in the Court of the Lord; they are hailed as true in the True Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਦੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa dee sobhaa jug jug hoee koi na metanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: Their praises echo throughout the ages, and no one can erase them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kai sad balihaarai jin har raakhiaa ur dhaaraa ||8||1||
lines.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine the Lord within their hearts. ||8||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਦੁਤੁਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 3 dutukee ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਗੁਣਿਆ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: niguniaa no aape bakhas lae bhaaee satigur kee sevaa laai ||
lines.translation: He Himself forgives the worthless, O Siblings of Destiny; He commits them to the service of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਊਤਮ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa ootam hai bhaaee raam naam chit laai ||1||
lines.translation: Service to the True Guru is sublime, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, one's consciousness is attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu aape bakhas milaai ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord forgives, and unites with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਹੀਣ ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gunaheen ham aparaadhee bhaaee poorai satigur lae ralaai || rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sinner, totally without virtue, O Siblings of Destiny; the Perfect True Guru has blended me. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣ ਕਉਣ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਬਖਸਿਅਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun kaun aparaadhee bakhasian piaare saachai sabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: So many, so many sinners have been forgiven, O beloved one, by contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੇੜੈ ਚਾੜਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhaujal paar utaarian bhaaee satigur beRai chaaR ||2||
lines.translation: They got on board the boat of the True Guru, who carried them across the terrifying world-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਰੈ ਤੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manoorai te ka(n)chan bhae bhaaee gur paaras mel milaai ||
lines.translation: I have been transformed from rusty iron into gold, O Siblings of Destiny, united in Union with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aap chhod naau man vasiaa bhaaee jotee jot milaai ||3||
lines.translation: Eliminating my self-conceit, the Name has come to dwell within my mind, O Siblings of Destiny; my light has merged in the Light. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree hau vaaranai bhaaee satigur kau sad balihaarai jaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice, O Siblings of Destiny, I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan jin ditaa bhaaee guramat sahaj samaau ||4||
lines.translation: He has given me the treasure of the Naam; O Siblings of Destiny, through the Guru's Teachings, I am absorbed in celestial bliss. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin sahaj na oopajai bhaaee poochhahu giaaneeaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, celestial peace is not produced, O Siblings of Destiny; go and ask the spiritual teachers about this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa sadaa kar bhaaee vichahu aap gavaai ||5||
lines.translation: Serve the True Guru forever, O Siblings of Destiny, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਭਉ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee bhau oopajai bhaaee bhau karanee sach saar ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, the Fear of God is produced, O Siblings of Destiny; true and excellent are the deeds done in the Fear of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: prem padaarath paaeeai bhaaee sach naam aadhaar ||6||
lines.translation: Then, one is blessed with the treasure of the Lord's Love, O Siblings of Destiny, and the Support of the True Name. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo satigur sevahi aapanaa bhaaee tin kai hau laagau paai ||
lines.translation: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਲਈ ਬਖਸਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: janam savaaree aapanaa bhaaee kul bhee laee bakhasaai ||7||
lines.translation: I have fulfilled my life, O Siblings of Destiny, and my family has been saved as well. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach baanee sach sabad hai bhaaee gur kirapaa te hoi ||
lines.translation: The True Word of the Guru's Bani, and the True Word of the Shabad, O Siblings of Destiny, are obtained only by Guru's Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam har man vasai bhaaee tis bighan na laagai koi ||8||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, with the Name of the Lord abiding in one's mind, no obstacles stand in one's way, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||2||
